items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Whitby, he was out; Hap, he was drunk;

ctx.x: all of them got drunk tonight." You know, we was playing all right, pretty good, but of course, when we got drunk, we started jamming. Didn't try to play no music. All them cats couldn't read no music, high and drunk as they was. Whitby, he was out; Hap, he was drunk; Charlie Toran, the piano player, he was drunk.

So King said, "Well, I'll be damned! I'm here taking the band over, and all these cats done got drunk on me. If they start off this way, what the hell they gonna do in the season?" So we got together on them, and we cussed them out, we did. I cussed a lot of them out, Pete did, Jack Holt, Sam -- we give 'em hell, you know what I mean. For gettin' drunk, you know what I mean? They went out there and got drunk, man. It was disgraceful. On the bandstand... Here's a cat laying up on the bandstand this-a-way. That…
